claimScope.provesIfPasses: Benchmark-scoped evidence that the real GPT-2 live pipeline can automatically scan layers/top activation-contribution neurons, build a token/neuron/target graph, and validate the graph through joint causal ablation above graph-level negative controls across a factual prompt set.
claimScope.doesNotProve: This is not attention-head/path recovery yet, not full GPT-2 FFN extraction, not arbitrary LLM understanding, and not output-only original-neuron identity.
